title: Cosmic Elephant Bubble
description: A stylized green elephant with intricate golden line details and one glowing golden eye, positioned in profile facing left while blowing iridescent pink and purple bubbles from its trunk. The creature is set against a swirling cosmic background of magenta, purple and dark space with ethereal smoke and golden particles.
prompt: A stylized green elephant with intricate black and golden linework and a glowing golden eye, shown in profile blowing large iridescent pink bubbles from its trunk. The creature floats in a swirling cosmic nebula of vibrant magenta, purple and dark space with ethereal smoke and floating golden particles, surreal fantasy digital painting style with luminous quality.
